answer_1.quote: Following the original evaluation on SUPER-NI and LONGFORM, we leverage ROUGE-L and METEOR as the metrics.
answer_1.outputs: Models trained with DYNOSAUR generate text outputs evaluated using ROUGE-L, METEOR, and human evaluation on helpfulness, honesty, and harmlessness across diverse NLP tasks including title generation and paraphrase identification.
